The symbol graph tags `findEnclosingSgSymbols` as `[untested]`, but that's wrong. A text search finds four test files that import and call it directly:

- `tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts`: calls it directly in "findEnclosingSgSymbols derives real symbols from readmap metadata". It also reaches it through `registerSgTool` in "ast_search tool derives enclosing symbols before display range merging", which sets `PI_CONTEXT_HYGIENE_DEBUG=1`.
- `tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts`
- `tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts`
- `tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts`

Its only caller in the source is `registerSgTool` (`src/sg.ts:415`). That call only happens when `PI_CONTEXT_HYGIENE_DEBUG=1` and the number of matched files is within the cap. So the many other tests that use `registerSgTool` (`sg.*.test.ts`, `sg-output-consumers.test.ts`, etc.) never set that variable and never reach the function. Three other test files mention the variable (`documentation-context-hygiene`, `documentation-content`, `context-hygiene-debug-tool`). From the import list, none of them imports `src/sg.js`, so they shouldn't reach it either.

<answer>
tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts
tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts
tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts
tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts
</answer>
